title: Robber’s Cave Dehradun - Nature Walk & Travel Guide
content:
Robber’s Cave - Dehradun,

obber’s Cave, locally known as Guchhu Pani, is a natural wonder located about 8 km from Dehradun city. It is a long, narrow cave with a river flowing inside it. Walking through the cool stream of water between tall rocks feels like stepping into a magical place.

The cave is about 600 meters long and has a waterfall inside, making it a favorite picnic and weekend spot. The name “Robber’s Cave” comes from a story that robbers once used the cave to hide from the British.

Today, it is one of the most popular places in Dehradun for families, couples, and adventure lovers.

Best Time to Visit Robber’s Cave:

  • Peak Season (March – June): Summer, 20°C – 35°C. Best to enjoy walking in the cool water.
  • Moderate Season (October – February): Winter, 5°C – 18°C. Pleasant weather, but water can be cold.
  • Low Season (July – September): Monsoon, 18°C – 28°C. Area may get slippery, but greenery looks beautiful.

Things to Do at Robber’s Cave:

  • Walk through the cool stream inside the cave.
  • Enjoy a mini waterfall inside the cave.
  • Click amazing photos of rock formations.
  • Try local snacks and maggi from small shops nearby.
  • Relax and enjoy a family picnic.

How to Reach:

  • By Road: 8 km from Dehradun Clock Tower, easily reachable by auto or taxi.
  • By Train: Nearest railway station is Dehradun (9 km).
  • By Air: Nearest airport is Jolly Grant Airport (32 km).

Best Places to Visit Near Robber’s Cave (within 50 km):

1- Sahastradhara (14 km): Sulphur springs and waterfalls.

2- Tapkeshwar Mahadev Temple (10 km): Shiva temple inside a natural cave.

3- Mindrolling Monastery (11 km): Beautiful Tibetan monastery.

4- Dehradun Zoo (15 km): Family-friendly wildlife park.

5- Forest Research Institute (8 km): Iconic colonial building and museum.

6- Lachhiwala Nature Park (22 km): Picnic and nature spot with pools.

7- Mussoorie (33 km): Famous hill station with waterfalls and viewpoints.

8- Malsi Deer Park (13 km): Small wildlife park for kids and families.

9- Shikhar Falls (13 km): Hidden waterfall for trekkers.

10- Kalsi (43 km): Historical site with Ashokan rock edicts.
excerpt: Robber’s Cave in Dehradun, also called Guchhu Pani, is a natural cave with a stream and waterfall running inside. It’s a unique picnic spot where visitors can walk barefoot in cold water between tall rocks. A must-visit place near Dehradun for nature lovers and families.

faqs.question: Why is it called Robber’s Cave?
faqs.answer: Because robbers once used it to hide during the British rule.

faqs.question: Can we take kids to Robber’s Cave?
faqs.answer: Yes, but supervise them as water can be slippery.

faqs.question: Is it safe during monsoon?
faqs.answer: Yes, but be cautious as rocks and water flow can be slippery.
